input: Give the valid status sequence for a successful approved work item from creation through completion and name the boundary that starts execution.

facts: Work starts only after an approved item is claimed by a worker.
constraints: Use one arrow-delimited sequence and one boundary sentence.

rubric.description: Orders pending approval, approved, running, and succeeded.
Does not skip approval before running.
Names the lease-bound worker claim as the execution boundary.

reference.content:
pending_approval -> approved -> running -> succeeded
Execution starts at the lease-bound worker claim.
